The 22 new transaction/executor sites are private-owner-qa-executor, separately inventoried with exact source/SQL identity and enforced runtime import containment. They are not deployed production ownership, nonauthorizing classifications, or a reduction of the historical 426 findings. Source and isolated QA evidence never authorize production cutover.
